svg.title: EgoAIM: observations, future 3D interaction, and structured intention
svg.desc: One second of egocentric RGB and gaze observations precedes one second of ground-truth 3D hand-object interaction. The state freezes at action completion. Bidirectional mapping relates the 2D placement point to the 3D support plane. Left hand: no intention. Right hand: Grasp, Dumbbell, Grip; Place, Light wooden square table; 2D point [468, 794].

svg.title: Structured intention: independent left and right hand annotations
